description: MeuRPG API log line (the backend log contract, backend/internal/platform/logging) to ECS. Accepts a line already parsed by Filebeat (`json`) or a raw JSON string in `message` (Pub/Sub, curl). Unknown keys are kept under meurpg.*; no step fails the document.

json.description: A raw JSON line in `message` (not parsed by Filebeat) becomes `json`.
json.if: ctx.json == null && ctx.message instanceof String && ctx.message.trim().startsWith('{')

remove.description: The raw line is replaced by the contract's `message`.
remove.if: ctx.json instanceof Map && ctx.json.message instanceof String

script.description: duration_ms (float) to event.duration (ns); the Cloud Logging trace key to trace.id. Both keys are removed from `json` so they do not land under meurpg.*.

date.description: time (RFC 3339, nanoseconds) to @timestamp, keeping the nanoseconds.

rename.description: Everything else in the contract (procedure, code, reason, campaign_id, event, ...) keeps its name under meurpg.*.
